name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Context menu with backdrop blur, click-outside dismissal, shortcut badges, and accessible keyboard navigation.

examples.title: Action Menu Dropdown
examples.description: Dropdown with labels, separators, and shortcut badges.
examples.code:
<Dropdown>
  <DropdownTrigger>
    <Button variant="secondary" rightIcon={<ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}>Options</Button>
  </DropdownTrigger>
  <DropdownContent>
    <DropdownLabel>Actions</DropdownLabel>
    <DropdownItem icon={<Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} shortcut="⌘C">Copy Code</DropdownItem>
    <DropdownSeparator />
    <DropdownItem destructive icon={<Trash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}>Delete</DropdownItem>
  </DropdownContent>
</Dropdown>
